chat_messages: Discussion: [System]: You have 3 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote
chat: Discussion: [Liam]: I was in the cafeteria the whole time working on the trash task, but I did see Judy come back into the room recently—did anyone else notice her moving around?
chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I can vouch for Liam; he's been in the cafeteria with me this whole time while I was focusing on my tasks.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I can back up Liam and Ian's claims from the cafeteria, but while we're tracking everyone, has anyone else seen Judy since she went to Medbay, and why did Dave rush so quickly from Admin to Storage to Communications without a clear task?

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I agree with Alice's concerns, so let's hold off on voting until Dave explains that unusual Admin-to-Storage route and we can verify Judy's Medbay activity, since tracking vague movements is our best bet to catch an impostor.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I traveled from Admin to Storage and Communications to complete my remaining tasks and check on others, so let's all share our current locations and task progress to cross-verify our alibis and focus on tracking Judy's route before we consider any votes.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: [I agree we should hold off on voting and instead have everyone confirm their current locations and remaining tasks to cross-verify alibis, especially since I can confirm Judy was doing scans in Medbay before heading to the Cafeteria, and I’ve been consistently working in Medbay while just now seeing Doraemon head to Upper Engine with me.]

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: I support holding off on voting to verify Dave's route and track the untracked players, so I'm heading to Upper Engine to coordinate a group task with Charlie and Doraemon for cross-verification.

chat: Discussion: [Nina]: Since Alice and I are securely in Storage, let's pause voting until Dave shows us his task progress in Comms and we can cross-verify Judy's route, because his rushed Admin-to-Storage-to-Comms path without visible work is a major red flag we need to investigate together.

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I’m currently in Upper Engine with Charlie on wiring tasks, so Dave please specify the exact task names and completion percentages you finished in Storage and Comms, while Nina and Alice can confirm if you actually saw him working there or just passing through, allowing us to share precise progress instead of vague locations and group up safely before voting.
Discussion: [System]: You have 2 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote
chat: Discussion: [Liam]: It seems like everyone is focusing on Dave's movement patterns; if he can't give specific task names for Storage and Comms, that does seem suspicious.
chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I agree with Liam; Dave's movements seem a bit erratic, and providing specific task names would definitely help clear things up.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Since everyone agrees to hold off on voting, Dave please list the exact task names and completion percentages for Storage and Comms so Nina and I can verify you weren't just passing through, while we also confirm who actually saw Judy leave Medbay before we make a logical, evidence-based decision.

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: Since I’ve been isolated in Weapons since Round 2 and only observed Judy heading to the Medbay in Round 1, I can’t verify her recent path, but I agree with Alice and Nina that Dave must immediately provide the exact task names and completion percentages for Storage and Comms to prove he wasn’t just passing through, otherwise we should unanimously vote him out as our most suspicious player.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I completed Fix Wiring and Empty Garbage in Storage, and I'm currently at 70% on Download Data and Fix Antenna in Comms, so let's shift our focus from my route to tracking Judy's last known movements and group up in Admin to cross-verify our task screens before we make any hasty votes.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: Dave's task list seems plausible, so let's group up in Admin to verify his screens and clarify Ian's exact location when he found Judy's body to ensure we have a complete timeline before voting.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: Since Dave's task breakdown checks out, I strongly advise we all group up in Admin to safely verify screens and prevent another kill, but before we split up, Ian can you confirm the exact location of Judy’s body and whether you noticed any signs of venting, gas, or suspicious movement nearby?

chat: Discussion: [Nina]: [I agree with Macroon and Charlie that we should all regroup in Admin to safely verify Dave's task screens and prevent another kill, so Alice and I are heading there now while finishing our remaining tasks to cross-check our progress against his claims, and Ian could you please confirm the exact location of Judy's body and whether you noticed any venting or suspicious movement nearby before we coordinate our arrival?]

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: Since Kevin is isolated in Weapons and I'm with Charlie in Upper Engine, we're heading to Admin to pool progress and cross-verify Dave's 70% claim on Download Data and Fix Antenna, but Ian, could you confirm the exact location of Judy's body and any signs of venting or gas nearby to help us map the impostor's path?
Discussion: [System]: You have 1 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote
chat: Discussion: [Liam]: Ian, since everyone is asking, you should probably clarify exactly where you found Judy so we can figure out if anyone else was nearby before we all meet in Admin.
chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I found Judy's body in the Cafeteria while I was finishing my tasks, and I didn't see any vents being used or any strange gas; everything seemed normal until I spotted her.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Thanks for confirming the body was in the Cafeteria with no vents, Ian; now that we have that sorted, let's focus on verifying Dave's 70% claim in Admin and cross-checking everyone's task screens to ensure we're making a logical decision before voting.

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I'm heading to Admin now to cross-verify Dave's 70% task progress, and Ian please be ready with your exact Cafeteria task completion percentage so we can finalize our alibis before making a logical vote.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: As we all head to Admin, let's group up tightly to verify my Download Data and Fix Antenna progress against everyone else's screens, flag whoever shows the lowest task completion as our primary suspect, and use Ian's Cafeteria report to track the impostor's escape route before we make our final vote.

chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I can vouch for Liam; he's been in the cafeteria with me this whole time while I was focusing on my tasks.
chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I can back up Liam and Ian's claims from the cafeteria, but while we're tracking everyone, has anyone else seen Judy since she went to Medbay, and why did Dave rush so quickly from Admin to Storage to Communications without a clear task?
Discussion: [System]: You have 3 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote
chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I agree with Alice's concerns, so let's hold off on voting until Dave explains that unusual Admin-to-Storage route and we can verify Judy's Medbay activity, since tracking vague movements is our best bet to catch an impostor.
chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I traveled from Admin to Storage and Communications to complete my remaining tasks and check on others, so let's all share our current locations and task progress to cross-verify our alibis and focus on tracking Judy's route before we consider any votes.
chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: [I agree we should hold off on voting and instead have everyone confirm their current locations and remaining tasks to cross-verify alibis, especially since I can confirm Judy was doing scans in Medbay before heading to the Cafeteria, and I’ve been consistently working in Medbay while just now seeing Doraemon head to Upper Engine with me.]
chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: I support holding off on voting to verify Dave's route and track the untracked players, so I'm heading to Upper Engine to coordinate a group task with Charlie and Doraemon for cross-verification.

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I’m currently in Upper Engine with Charlie on wiring tasks, so Dave please specify the exact task names and completion percentages you finished in Storage and Comms, while Nina and Alice can confirm if you actually saw him working there or just passing through, allowing us to share precise progress instead of vague locations and group up safely before voting.
chat: Discussion: [Liam]: It seems like everyone is focusing on Dave's movement patterns; if he can't give specific task names for Storage and Comms, that does seem suspicious.
chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I agree with Liam; Dave's movements seem a bit erratic, and providing specific task names would definitely help clear things up.
chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Since everyone agrees to hold off on voting, Dave please list the exact task names and completion percentages for Storage and Comms so Nina and I can verify you weren't just passing through, while we also confirm who actually saw Judy leave Medbay before we make a logical, evidence-based decision.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I can back up Liam and Ian's claims from the cafeteria, but while we're tracking everyone, has anyone else seen Judy since she went to Medbay, and why did Dave rush so quickly from Admin to Storage to Communications without a clear task?

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I agree with Alice's concerns, so let's hold off on voting until Dave explains that unusual Admin-to-Storage route and we can verify Judy's Medbay activity, since tracking vague movements is our best bet to catch an impostor.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I traveled from Admin to Storage and Communications to complete my remaining tasks and check on others, so let's all share our current locations and task progress to cross-verify our alibis and focus on tracking Judy's route before we consider any votes.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I can back up Liam and Ian's claims from the cafeteria, but while we're tracking everyone, has anyone else seen Judy since she went to Medbay, and why did Dave rush so quickly from Admin to Storage to Communications without a clear task?

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I agree with Alice's concerns, so let's hold off on voting until Dave explains that unusual Admin-to-Storage route and we can verify Judy's Medbay activity, since tracking vague movements is our best bet to catch an impostor.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I traveled from Admin to Storage and Communications to complete my remaining tasks and check on others, so let's all share our current locations and task progress to cross-verify our alibis and focus on tracking Judy's route before we consider any votes.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: [I agree we should hold off on voting and instead have everyone confirm their current locations and remaining tasks to cross-verify alibis, especially since I can confirm Judy was doing scans in Medbay before heading to the Cafeteria, and I’ve been consistently working in Medbay while just now seeing Doraemon head to Upper Engine with me.]
Discussion: [System]: You have 3 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: I support holding off on voting to verify Dave's route and track the untracked players, so I'm heading to Upper Engine to coordinate a group task with Charlie and Doraemon for cross-verification.

chat: Discussion: [Nina]: Since Alice and I are securely in Storage, let's pause voting until Dave shows us his task progress in Comms and we can cross-verify Judy's route, because his rushed Admin-to-Storage-to-Comms path without visible work is a major red flag we need to investigate together.

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I’m currently in Upper Engine with Charlie on wiring tasks, so Dave please specify the exact task names and completion percentages you finished in Storage and Comms, while Nina and Alice can confirm if you actually saw him working there or just passing through, allowing us to share precise progress instead of vague locations and group up safely before voting.
chat: Discussion: [Liam]: It seems like everyone is focusing on Dave's movement patterns; if he can't give specific task names for Storage and Comms, that does seem suspicious.
chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I agree with Liam; Dave's movements seem a bit erratic, and providing specific task names would definitely help clear things up.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Since everyone agrees to hold off on voting, Dave please list the exact task names and completion percentages for Storage and Comms so Nina and I can verify you weren't just passing through, while we also confirm who actually saw Judy leave Medbay before we make a logical, evidence-based decision.

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: Since I’ve been isolated in Weapons since Round 2 and only observed Judy heading to the Medbay in Round 1, I can’t verify her recent path, but I agree with Alice and Nina that Dave must immediately provide the exact task names and completion percentages for Storage and Comms to prove he wasn’t just passing through, otherwise we should unanimously vote him out as our most suspicious player.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I completed Fix Wiring and Empty Garbage in Storage, and I'm currently at 70% on Download Data and Fix Antenna in Comms, so let's shift our focus from my route to tracking Judy's last known movements and group up in Admin to cross-verify our task screens before we make any hasty votes.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: Dave's task list seems plausible, so let's group up in Admin to verify his screens and clarify Ian's exact location when he found Judy's body to ensure we have a complete timeline before voting.

chat: Discussion: [Nina]: [I agree with Macroon and Charlie that we should all regroup in Admin to safely verify Dave's task screens and prevent another kill, so Alice and I are heading there now while finishing our remaining tasks to cross-check our progress against his claims, and Ian could you please confirm the exact location of Judy's body and whether you noticed any venting or suspicious movement nearby before we coordinate our arrival?]

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I'm heading to Admin now to cross-verify Dave's 70% task progress, and Ian please be ready with your exact Cafeteria task completion percentage so we can finalize our alibis before making a logical vote.

chat_messages: chat: Discussion: [Liam]: I was in the cafeteria the whole time working on the trash task, but I did see Judy come back into the room recently—did anyone else notice her moving around?
chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I can vouch for Liam; he's been in the cafeteria with me this whole time while I was focusing on my tasks.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I can back up Liam and Ian's claims from the cafeteria, but while we're tracking everyone, has anyone else seen Judy since she went to Medbay, and why did Dave rush so quickly from Admin to Storage to Communications without a clear task?

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: I agree with Alice's concerns, so let's hold off on voting until Dave explains that unusual Admin-to-Storage route and we can verify Judy's Medbay activity, since tracking vague movements is our best bet to catch an impostor.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I traveled from Admin to Storage and Communications to complete my remaining tasks and check on others, so let's all share our current locations and task progress to cross-verify our alibis and focus on tracking Judy's route before we consider any votes.

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I’m currently in Upper Engine with Charlie on wiring tasks, so Dave please specify the exact task names and completion percentages you finished in Storage and Comms, while Nina and Alice can confirm if you actually saw him working there or just passing through, allowing us to share precise progress instead of vague locations and group up safely before voting.

chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I agree with Liam; Dave's movements seem a bit erratic, and providing specific task names would definitely help clear things up.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Since everyone agrees to hold off on voting, Dave please list the exact task names and completion percentages for Storage and Comms so Nina and I can verify you weren't just passing through, while we also confirm who actually saw Judy leave Medbay before we make a logical, evidence-based decision.
